title: CaLR: Causal Latent Revision for Robust Diffusion Reasoning
description:
arXiv:2609.20981v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models suffer from local greediness, while diffusion language models (DLMs) often lack the strict causal structure required for reasoning. To combine the advantages and overcome the drawbacks of the dual, we propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization.
